page.notes: Public Russian-language adult-video catalog. Requested URL redirects cross-host to sex-studentki.live.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated light and dark screenshots plus CSS signal inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Light and dark captures are byte-identical (339,279 bytes each); the CSS probe found no color-scheme declaration or prefers-color-scheme rule. The interface is hard-coded dark.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and inspected active animations/CSS
checkOutcomes.evidence: Six animations remained present under reduce, including running 3,000 ms and 6,000 ms animations; no prefers-reduced-motion rule was found.

checkOutcomes.method: Forced-colors and prefers-contrast screenshot inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Forced-colors capture retained visible text, icons, borders, and controls with strong yellow-on-black system colors.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected CSS and route/state behaviour across MPA pages
checkOutcomes.evidence: Navigation is cross-document and swaps abruptly; CSS inspection found no view-transition-name or cross-document View Transition rule.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected CSS and page motion

checkOutcomes.reason: The audited templates contain no scroll-linked parallax, scrollytelling, or reveal motion to implement.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected mobile layouts and interaction code signals
checkOutcomes.evidence: Core browsing uses native links, scrolling and native range controls; no pointermove-driven custom gesture that fights the platform was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected long mobile page and CSS scroll-state signals
checkOutcomes.evidence: The 31,795 px homepage keeps static header/navigation chrome and exposes no scroll progress or scroll-state response; no scroll-state query or scroll timeline was found.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected DOM for tooltips/popovers and CSS anchor positioning
checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip or edge-attached menu requiring anchor positioning was present on the representative paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip or edge-attached menu requiring anchor positioning was present on the representative paths.

checkOutcomes.method: Walked homepage section links and detail navigation
checkOutcomes.evidence: Descriptive section links and visible arrow affordances take users directly to latest, trending, category and detail surfaces; destination headings are visibly distinct.

checkOutcomes.method: Visual inspection on homepage/listing load
checkOutcomes.evidence: A fixed promotional card for “Лара, 19” overlays the lower portion of listing content before user interaction.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM and screenshot inspection of promotional overlay
checkOutcomes.evidence: The load-time promotion is custom ad markup/links; the page has zero dialog, popover or details elements, so dismissal and semantics are hand-rolled.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared content area with persistent chrome and promotion
checkOutcomes.evidence: Content cards dominate most of the page, but the fixed promotional card occupies roughly the lower quarter of the mobile listing viewport and competes with the core catalog.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured 360x800 layout and inspected mobile screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: Layout reports scrollWidth 360, clientWidth 360 and 0 px horizontal overflow; viewport metadata is present and cards reflow to two columns.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared card/player presentation across desktop and mobile
checkOutcomes.evidence: Category cards, listing cards and the player visibly adapt from the desktop grid to narrow layouts without clipping, even though no container-query syntax was found.

checkOutcomes.method: Programmatically focused controls and reviewed Lighthouse target-size audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Focused links consistently computed outline-style none/0px, and Lighthouse failed target-size; several header controls measure about 42 px rather than the recommended 44 px minimum.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected first viewport and navigation labels
checkOutcomes.evidence: The logo, category grid, New/Popular links, listing cards and play affordance make browsing and watching videos immediately understandable.

checkOutcomes.method: Walked homepage to listing to a representative video detail
checkOutcomes.evidence: A user can select a category/listing card, reach a descriptive video page, and access a prominent player with native-like playback controls without an account wall.

checkOutcomes.method: Requested a secondary feedback route during the journey
checkOutcomes.evidence: One feedback-route capture returned a bare “429 Too Many Requests” page with no retry timing, back link, branded recovery, or preserved context.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse and a DevTools trace
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse lab LCP was 8.1 s (performance 0.66), outside the 2.5 s good threshold; trace under a separate run measured LCP 1.11 s, so the slower throttled result remains the risk signal.

checkOutcomes.method: Observed layout shifts and audited image dimensions
checkOutcomes.evidence: Detail layout recorded CLS 0.0809 and the image audit found all 94 images lacked explicit width/height, leaving late-load shift risk.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran trace and long-task observers
checkOutcomes.evidence: Trace found one 67.4 ms long task and only 17.4 ms total blocking time; homepage layout observed one 75 ms task, proportionate for the page.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR and confirmed resource placement against DOM
checkOutcomes.evidence: HAR recorded 122 requests/1.80 MB, parser-inserted render-blocking CSS and a synchronous compressed.js; image audit found 88 below-fold images without lazy loading.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse unused-code diagnostics

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse accessibility audits and DOM probes

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse color-contrast audit and forced-colors capture

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected headings/landmarks and focused controls

checkOutcomes.method: Visual inspection at desktop and 360 px mobile

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected viewport, media tracks and Lighthouse target sizing

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse errors-in-console audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reported no browser errors logged to the console.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected document mode/charset and image audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Rendered documents are standards mode UTF-8, but all 94 audited images lack explicit width/height and 93 lack srcset, weakening asset structure and sizing.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse best-practices audits and inspected anchors

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected rendered and raw metadata across home/detail
checkOutcomes.evidence: Homepage and representative detail have descriptive, unique titles and meta descriptions, preserved in raw HTML.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse SEO and inspected anchors/viewport
checkOutcomes.evidence: Viewport metadata is present and indexing is allowed, but Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors; javascript:return false/javascript:false links are used for search controls.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected status, canonical, robots and sitemap signals

checkOutcomes.method: Audited protocol, security headers and cookies

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR and tracker/cookie inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage contacted 10 third-party origins/21 requests (208,158 bytes), including Yandex analytics and multiple advertising/tracking origins, before visible consent.

checkOutcomes.reason: No permission prompt or authentication flow is part of the public video-browsing journey; passkey suitability could not apply to an absent auth flow.

checkOutcomes.method: Repeated menu/search toggles and inspected mobile overlays
checkOutcomes.evidence: Twenty menu/search toggle cycles left DOM node and animation counts stable; the main player and menu remained usable at narrow width.

checkOutcomes.method: Checked manifest/service worker and site type

checkOutcomes.reason: This is a media catalog whose core video delivery is intrinsically online; installability/offline video was judged out of scope.

checkOutcomes.reason: The audited surfaces show no dates, currencies, localized numbers, calendars or durations requiring locale formatting beyond video timecodes.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected representative content and forms
checkOutcomes.evidence: No scheduled events, user time zones or DST-sensitive date/time data are present.
checkOutcomes.reason: No scheduled events, user time zones or DST-sensitive date/time data are present.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected load-time promotion and outgoing destination
checkOutcomes.evidence: A profile-styled “Лара, 19” promotional card overlays catalog content and routes to a third-party click-tracking URL, blurring editorial UI and advertising.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected feedback/comment forms and failure page

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected form autocomplete metadata
checkOutcomes.evidence: The feedback email input has an associated label but no type=email or autocomplete=email token; comment name/message fields also omit autocomplete guidance.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected representative public paths
checkOutcomes.evidence: No checkout, subscription, consent purchase, authentication or account-management flow was exercised or required for the primary task.
checkOutcomes.reason: No checkout, subscription, consent purchase, authentication or account-management flow was exercised or required for the primary task.

checkOutcomes.evidence: 93 of 94 images use WebP and only 2 were more than 2x display width; most catalog thumbnails are close to their rendered size.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured third-party bytes and autoplay
checkOutcomes.evidence: No video autoplays on the detail page, but homepage third parties cost 21 requests/208 KB and include analytics, ad and click-tracking origins.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected source signals and site purpose
checkOutcomes.evidence: This public media catalog exposes no transaction/productivity capability that requires a WebMCP tool; absence is an emerging opportunity, not a failure.
checkOutcomes.reason: This public media catalog exposes no transaction/productivity capability that requires a WebMCP tool; absence is an emerging opportunity, not a failure.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarisation or language-model task is needed for the primary browse/watch journey; on-device inference is not applicable.
checkOutcomes.reason: No summarisation or language-model task is needed for the primary browse/watch journey; on-device inference is not applicable.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared baseline/post heap summaries after repeated menu/search toggles
checkOutcomes.evidence: After 20 menu and search toggles, in-session JS heap was unchanged and DOM nodes fell by 3; independent heap summaries grew only 176,809 bytes (1.7%), with closures +18.

checkOutcomes.method: Read heap summary totals and DOM metrics
checkOutcomes.evidence: Baseline heap self-size was 10.44 MB with 191,549 snapshot nodes and about 2,134 live DOM elements, proportionate to a 94-image catalog page.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared heap constructor populations and repeated-interaction metrics
checkOutcomes.evidence: Top constructor summaries show no Detached* population; after repeated toggles DOM nodes were -3, animations unchanged, and closures increased only 18 between independently loaded snapshots.

principleOutcomes.reason: This public media catalog exposes no transaction/productivity capability that requires a WebMCP tool; absence is an emerging opportunity, not a failure. No summarisation or language-model task is needed for the primary browse/watch journey; on-device inference is not applicable.

paths.description: Homepage: catalog entry, navigation, category grid, long content feed and global privacy/performance signals. Represents the global shell.
All-videos listing: representative card/feed template and load-time promotional overlay.
Representative video detail: primary watch journey, player, metadata, comments and related content.
Feedback form and HTTP failure/recovery archetype. One capture hit rate limiting; a later DOM probe reached the form.

findings.summary: Promotional overlay obscures catalog content
findings.evidence: A fixed promotional card for “Лара, 19” overlays the lower portion of listing content before user interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not display the promotion before interaction; place clearly labelled advertising in document flow or defer it until after an explicit action.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and touch target support are weak
findings.evidence: Focused links consistently computed outline-style none/0px, and Lighthouse failed target-size; several header controls measure about 42 px rather than the recommended 44 px minimum.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore a high-contrast :focus-visible ring and ensure interactive hit areas meet at least 44 by 44 CSS px or equivalent spacing.

findings.summary: Rate-limit failure is a dead end
findings.evidence: One feedback-route capture returned a bare “429 Too Many Requests” page with no retry timing, back link, branded recovery, or preserved context.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a branded 429 state with Retry-After guidance, a retry control, navigation back to content and preserved form input.

findings.summary: Throttled LCP is slow
findings.evidence: Lighthouse lab LCP was 8.1 s (performance 0.66), outside the 2.5 s good threshold; trace under a separate run measured LCP 1.11 s, so the slower throttled result remains the risk signal.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP thumbnail/hero, reduce eager image competition, and verify LCP under Lighthouse throttling and field data.

findings.summary: Homepage eagerly delivers too many resources
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 122 requests/1.80 MB, parser-inserted render-blocking CSS and a synchronous compressed.js; image audit found 88 below-fold images without lazy loading.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold thumbnails, defer noncritical scripts, and keep only truly critical CSS/scripts in the blocking path.

findings.summary: Controls, links, images and iframe lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed button-name, link-name, frame-title and image-alt; image inspection found 13 images without alt, and the tracking iframe has no title.
findings.suggestedFix: Add discernible labels to icon controls, meaningful/empty alt as appropriate, and a descriptive title on the third-party iframe.

findings.summary: Missing landmarks, H1 and focus indicators
findings.evidence: Homepage has no H1 or landmark elements, starts at H3, and focused controls computed no visible outline; Lighthouse failed landmark-one-main.
findings.suggestedFix: Add main/nav/header/footer landmarks, one descriptive H1 on the homepage, and visible :focus-visible treatment in logical tab order.

findings.summary: Primary videos have no captions and targets are small
findings.evidence: Viewport allows up to 2x scaling and reflows, but Lighthouse failed touch target size and the primary 33-minute video exposes no caption/subtitle track.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide caption/subtitle tracks for videos and enlarge or space failing touch targets.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie protections are missing
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS and nosniff are absent; 3 first-party cookies are not Secure and every observed cookie uses SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrictive CSP, HSTS and nosniff; mark cookies Secure and choose Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is strictly required.

findings.summary: Tracking and ad requests run before visible consent
findings.evidence: The homepage contacted 10 third-party origins/21 requests (208,158 bytes), including Yandex analytics and multiple advertising/tracking origins, before visible consent.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unnecessary third parties and gate nonessential analytics/ads behind clear consent; batch/minimise retained analytics data.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defenses are absent
findings.evidence: No HSTS, clickjacking defense, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy or CSP frame-ancestors was present, despite a third-party iframe on the video page.
findings.suggestedFix: Set CSP frame-ancestors, HSTS, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; evaluate Trusted Types for script-sensitive surfaces.

findings.summary: HTTP 429 state has no recovery
findings.evidence: A rate-limited feedback request produced only a generic 429 page without a retry action, retry-after guidance, cached shell or branded navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve an intentional error template with retry timing, navigation and state preservation instead of the bare server error.

findings.summary: Russian pages do not declare their language
findings.evidence: Russian-language pages have an empty html lang attribute, no dir, and the loaded CSS exposed no logical-property signal; Lighthouse also failed html-has-lang.
findings.suggestedFix: Set html lang="ru", establish direction, and migrate layout rules to logical properties so translation and bidi layouts can adapt.

findings.summary: Profile-styled ad obscures its commercial nature
findings.evidence: A profile-styled “Лара, 19” promotional card overlays catalog content and routes to a third-party click-tracking URL, blurring editorial UI and advertising.
findings.suggestedFix: Label the promotion unambiguously as advertising, keep it out of the primary UI layer, and avoid click-tracking redirects that resemble profile navigation.

findings.summary: Below-fold catalog images load eagerly
findings.evidence: The homepage eagerly loads 102 image requests; 88 below-fold images omit loading=lazy, spending bandwidth on content far outside the first viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Add loading="lazy" and decoding="async" to below-fold thumbnails and cap initial catalog rendering/fetching.

findings.summary: Add preference-driven color themes
findings.evidence: Light and dark captures are byte-identical (339,279 bytes each); the CSS probe found no color-scheme declaration or prefers-color-scheme rule. The interface is hard-coded dark.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and use prefers-color-scheme/light-dark() so the current dark palette and a usable light palette follow the user.

findings.summary: Motion ignores reduced-motion preference
findings.evidence: Six animations remained present under reduce, including running 3,000 ms and 6,000 ms animations; no prefers-reduced-motion rule was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap nonessential animation in no-preference and disable or shorten it under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Promotional overlay uses custom semantics
findings.evidence: The load-time promotion is custom ad markup/links; the page has zero dialog, popover or details elements, so dismissal and semantics are hand-rolled.
findings.suggestedFix: If a transient promotion is retained, use popover/dialog semantics, a real button, keyboard focus management and declarative light-dismiss.

findings.summary: Promotion competes with core content
findings.evidence: Content cards dominate most of the page, but the fixed promotional card occupies roughly the lower quarter of the mobile listing viewport and competes with the core catalog.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the fixed promotion from the content viewport and preserve screen space for the catalog and player.

findings.summary: Images lack reserved dimensions
findings.evidence: Detail layout recorded CLS 0.0809 and the image audit found all 94 images lacked explicit width/height, leaving late-load shift risk.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio for every image and reserve player/ad space before resources load.

findings.summary: Substantial CSS and JavaScript is unused
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 105,137 bytes of unused JavaScript and 68,761 bytes of unused CSS, meaningful on a catalog homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Split page-specific player/catalog assets and remove unused selectors/code identified by coverage.

findings.summary: Image assets lack intrinsic sizing and responsive candidates
findings.evidence: Rendered documents are standards mode UTF-8, but all 94 audited images lack explicit width/height and 93 lack srcset, weakening asset structure and sizing.
findings.suggestedFix: Add width/height and useful srcset/sizes to catalog images while preserving WebP delivery.

findings.summary: Inspector issues and javascript: links remain
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported DevTools inspector issues; several controls use javascript: href values instead of clean buttons/declarative actions.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace javascript: anchors with buttons/declarative actions, resolve DevTools Issues, and preserve real href values only for navigation.

findings.summary: Interactive javascript: anchors fail crawlability
findings.evidence: Viewport metadata is present and indexing is allowed, but Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors; javascript:return false/javascript:false links are used for search controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Use buttons for actions and real href links for navigation so crawlers and keyboard users receive correct semantics.

findings.summary: Video pages lack VideoObject metadata
findings.evidence: Video detail supplies basic Open Graph tags but no JSON-LD/VideoObject structured data; og:video points to the page URL rather than a media asset.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject JSON-LD and point Open Graph video fields to valid media/embed metadata consistent with the visible page.

findings.summary: Forms and failure states offer weak recovery
findings.evidence: The feedback form fields are not marked required and the observed 429 response supplies no actionable recovery or inline explanation.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark requirements semantically, validate after interaction, announce errors, preserve input and provide actionable server-error recovery.

findings.summary: Third-party resource cost is disproportionate
findings.evidence: No video autoplays on the detail page, but homepage third parties cost 21 requests/208 KB and include analytics, ad and click-tracking origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Self-host the font where practical, remove redundant tracking/ad origins and defer approved third parties until needed.

findings.summary: Route changes swap abruptly
findings.evidence: Navigation is cross-document and swaps abruptly; CSS inspection found no view-transition-name or cross-document View Transition rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Add progressive cross-document View Transitions for navigation, retaining a normal navigation fallback.

findings.summary: Long pages provide no position-aware navigation feedback
findings.evidence: The 31,795 px homepage keeps static header/navigation chrome and exposes no scroll progress or scroll-state response; no scroll-state query or scroll timeline was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a lightweight scroll progress/scroll-state affordance so users can orient within long catalog pages.

findings.summary: Form fields omit useful input metadata
findings.evidence: The feedback email input has an associated label but no type=email or autocomplete=email token; comment name/message fields also omit autocomplete guidance.
findings.suggestedFix: Use type="email" and autocomplete="email" for contact email, plus appropriate autocomplete tokens for identity fields.
